threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the 149 bus never shows up, like it might be a mistake. Welcome to Dalston, mate.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with an off-key version of 'Wonderwall.' No one clapped, but we all kept our heads down pretending it was normal.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I realized I lived here was when I saw a guy in a purple fur coat juggling oranges outside the Spätkauf. Traffic stopped, and everyone cheered.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how you can spot a BVG bus just by its distinct rattling? It’s like a moving sound signature of this city.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows to check BART’s Twitter before heading to Civic Center—it's like a game of dice with your commute these days.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a lady with a bouquet of flowers calmly waiting as Muni was late again; she was the only one not looking frustrated. Just San Francisco vibes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all tapas places serve patatas bravas. The hidden gems have them as an afterthought, focusing instead on seasonal vegetables.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to understand the metro map; they’re the ones staring at it like it's a riddle.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it ‘the tube’ instead of just ‘the overground’ when you're hopping to Dalston. The locals can spot a newcomer from a mile away.
Last night, a guy on the 35 was passionately debating the merits of kebabs versus pizza—didn't notice when his stop rolled past.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Watching the old man feed the pigeons every morning at Maybachufer while the kids ride their bikes around him. That’s when it clicked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM and watch a spontaneous dance-off break out in the street. It’s a true Berlin moment.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART delays; a worker just stands confused, while we whip out our phones to check the chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy in a full tuxedo on the Muni, bow tie and all, juggling oranges. Only in the Tenderloin does a commute come with a show.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can eat paella anywhere—real locals know you won’t find a good one in Gràcia. It’s all about the tapas; stick to those.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still use Google Maps to navigate the Gothic Quarter; locals rarely pull it out, relying instead on instinct and memory.
